messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a small PLG launch: 30m mini-webinar + 3 onboarding nudges + 2 prompt template variants. Goal: lift first-5-requests and 7d retention. Run window 2 weeks starting next Mon.
leo: love it. Free credits for new signups only? we should cap to avoid noise.
maria: yes. 50 starter tokens, 24h expiry. cohorts by nudge order: A/B/C. templates V1/V2.
samir: add metrics: time-to-first-success, activation %, avg tokens per user, 7d retention. also a prompt-quality eval set for hallucination checks.
tayla: I can write webinar invite, two subject lines, and 3 short social posts. need asset deadline?
maria: Fri EOD so we can ship Mon. webinar CTA -> invite to try prompt templates + credits.
growth-bot: Experiment created: EX-1423 (owner: maria) — cohorts A/B/C, credit=50, templates=V1,V2. tracking: experiment_id=EX-1423.
leo: frontend needs a tiny landing param -> ?cohort=XXX and cookie. snippet:
```
// marketing landing
if (qs.cohort) setCookie('mkt_cohort', qs.cohort, {maxAge: 86400})
```
leo: that'll let backend map inbound leads to cohorts.
eng-frontend-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/templ-tour -> staging (2025-04-02 03:00 UTC).
ashley: inbound routing rule: signup_source in [webinar, demo] => cohort=B. I will implement once cookie is set.
samir: please record cohort in analytics event marketing.cohort_assigned with props cohort and signup_source.
leo: will add. also adding feature-flag for 'template tour' modal; tagging eng-frontend.
maria: support prep: there will be credit questions. @support-team add short FAQ + routing tag EX-1423.
ashley: noted. will add FAQ & ticket tag. also routing rule to send EX-1423 tickets to growth-support queue.
tayla: subject lines draft: 1) "Try Redwood: 50 starter tokens + live demo" 2) "Ship prompts faster — 30m demo and starter credits". sharing copy by Thu.
samir: one more ask: include 5-prompt eval harness to surface any quality regressions between V1 and V2.
maria: agree. finalize experiment plan doc and we'll have a post-launch benchmark thread to dump results. if >10% activation lift we scale.
leo: thumbs up. any blockers?
tayla: calendar invite created for mini-webinar. will drop landing copy to the doc.
maria: pinned doc: <https://redwood.app/docs/EX-1423> — review and flag blockers here. :rocket:
